captions.linkedin:
Decide now who fixes a rejected e-invoice after go-live (your ASP, your ERP team or finance), and name one person to coordinate all three.

In-scope businesses with revenue of AED 50m or more must implement e-invoicing by 1 January 2027 (Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, Art. 5(1)(a), as amended by Ministerial Resolution No. 66 of 2026; mof.gov.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026).

Three issues that need a named owner before January:
• An invoice the system rejects
• A customer record with missing buyer details
• A credit note that has to be corrected

Valorin is not an ASP. We can be your one contact between the ASP, the ERP team and finance, through testing to go-live.

Who owns these in your team today?

captions.facebook:
When an e-invoice bounces back in January, someone has to own the fix: decide now whether that's your ASP, your ERP team or finance.

For in-scope businesses with revenue of AED 50m or more, e-invoicing must be in place by 1 January 2027 (Ministerial Decision No. 244 of 2025, as amended by Ministerial Resolution No. 66 of 2026; mof.gov.ae, checked 12 Nov 2026).

In our view, many go-live problems sit between those three teams. One person coordinating them stops an issue being passed from team to team.
